content: Service role key must never reach the client; the standard pattern for a small internal app is a Supabase Edge Function that receives the caller's JWT (forwarded automatically by supabase-js functions.invoke when a session exists), verifies the caller server-side via supabase.auth.getUser(jwt) against an anon-key client, checks the caller's role from profiles, and only then constructs a second admin client using the service_role key (stored as an Edge Function secret, never shipped to the browser) to perform the privileged action.
